title: 第六章 开机，我敬仰苏总！（求追读）
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“受不了了？”李雪冲他勾了勾手：“受不了就跟我回家。”

“真的？”

苏行舟表现得很淡定，但是嘴角的弧度出卖了他。

“当然，你跟我从这里走回家，再从我家走回你自己家，不就消化了？”李雪绷着笑意：“吃太撑睡不着别怪我。”

“不用，我不撑了。”苏行舟笑得很假：“谢谢我的好妹妹！”

李雪听到好妹妹三个字，差点又急眼了。

苏行舟天赋异禀，规模有点太大了，刚才亲密接触，就隔着一层布料。

一想到自己刚才那么娇那么媚的喊他哥哥，李雪的脸又烧了起来。

“太晚了，我走了！”

李雪不和他贫嘴了，再聊下去真交代了，这苏行舟许久没见怎么那么会了。

之前是暧昧氛围，她还可惜没能再进一步就断了联系。

没想到刚恢复联系一天，就差点被苏行舟吃干抹净，他这半年上哪进修了。

以前都是她调戏小弟弟，现在是两只狐狸互相试探，探着探着就探进“沟”里了。

“注意安全，到家给我打个电话。”

苏行舟给她送上出租车，站在原地笑了笑。

和旧友再见的感觉，很不错。

前世，他和李雪只是合作了两次微短剧的合作伙伴，勉强算是暧昧对象。

因为一系列变故，等苏行舟腾出手时，她已经被于症选中。

他也就没有多余的想法，在电视上看到她无非祝福罢了。

看来重生一回，带给他的不止是事业的变化，还有很多惊喜等他去揭开。

..........

时间过得很快，从《白夜追凶》确认立项到开机过去不到两周。

对赌协议只剩一个半月时间，失败后也只有半个月时间给苏行舟筹款。

2013年2月25日。

苏行舟带着一行人在石景山区，首钢老厂区进行开机仪式。

这段时间，p站坚定站在潘岳明这边的行为被骂上了风口浪尖。

只要有上网的人就没有不骂的。

Page (1/3)

"Can't stand it anymore?" Li Xue hooked her hand at him: "If you can't stand it, just come home with me."

"Really?"

Su Xingzhou acted very calmly, but the curve of his mouth betrayed him.

"Of course, if you walk home from here with me, and then from my house back to your own house, won't you digest it?" Li Xue smiled tightly: "Don't blame me if you eat too much and can't sleep."

"No, I can't hold on anymore." Su Xingzhou smiled fakely: "Thank you, my good sister!"

When Li Xue heard the words "good sister", she almost became anxious again.

Su Xingzhou was extremely talented, but the scale was a bit too big. The intimate contact just now was separated by a layer of fabric.

Li Xue's face burned again when she thought of calling him brother so coquettishly and charmingly just now.

"It's too late, I'm leaving!"

Li Xue stopped chatting with him, and if she continued to chat, she would really explain why Su Xingzhou was so good after not seeing him for a long time.

It was an ambiguous atmosphere before, but she unfortunately broke off the contact before going any further.

Unexpectedly, just one day after the contact was restored, Su Xingzhou almost wiped him out. Where had he been studying in the past six months?

In the past, she was the one teasing her little brother, but now the two foxes are testing each other, probing and exploring into the "ditch".

"Be safe and call me when you get home."

Su Xingzhou sent her a taxi and stood there with a smile.

It feels good to see old friends again.

In his previous life, he and Li Xue were just partners in two mini-short dramas, and could barely be considered an affair.

Due to a series of changes, by the time Su Xingzhou was free, she had already been selected by Yu Zheng.

He had no extra thoughts. Seeing her on TV was nothing more than a blessing.

It seems that his rebirth will bring him not only changes in his career, but also many surprises waiting for him to uncover.

...........

Time flies so fast, less than two weeks have passed since the project of "White Night" was confirmed and started.

There was only one and a half months left in the gambling agreement, and after the failure, there was only half a month left to raise funds for Su Xingzhou.

February 25, 2013.

Su Xingzhou led a group of people to conduct a start-up ceremony in the old Shougang factory in Shijingshan District.

During this period, Station P was criticized for standing firmly on Pan Yueming's side.

As long as there is someone online, there will be no one who doesn’t criticize.
